blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States — The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on Wednesday authorized SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites as part of its plan to build data centers in space. Projects for orbiting data centers have multiplied since last year. Alongside SpaceX and its Starmind constellation, Google is pursuing its own work under the codename Suncatcher, while Blue Origin has submitted an application to the FCC for its “Project Sunrise.” Several startups are also in the race, including Starcloud, which successfully operated an advanced processor known as a GPU aboard a satellite in late 2025.
